title: Labor and Employment Associate Attorney (Remote)
description:
JOB SUMMARY:
We are a rapidly growing, tech-forward and successful Plaintiff-Side Labor and Employment Litigation Firm based in Los Angeles, California, seeking a skilled, detail-oriented and aggressive Associate Attorney to work in both our pre-litigation and litigation departments. This is a fully-remote position.

With the help of an experienced litigation paralegal and several other support staff members made accessible to you, you will be trusted to handle labor and employment cases, including single-plaintiff FEHA and wrongful termination matters as well as single-plaintiff wage and hour cases. (PAGA and class action experience is a plus.) You will also work closely with the firm's Managing Attorney.

We are seeking a candidate who is interested in building a long-term professional relationship. Ultimately, this is a unique opportunity to join a vibrant and cutting-edge law firm, engage in impactful work, and join a mission-driven team dedicated to advocating for employees' rights and achieving justice in the workplace.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Licensure and Residence: Licensed to practice law and resides in California;
  • Relevant Experience: At least two (2) years of dedicated labor and employment litigation experience (FEHA, wrongful termination, and wage and hour);
  • Detail-Oriented: You are diligent and carefully proofread your work;
  • Writing and Analysis: Strong writing and analytical skills, with experience drafting settlement demand letters, mediation briefs, motions (including MSJs), oppositions, and discovery requests/responses;
  • Litigation Skills: Proven ability to draft pleadings, motions and briefs, take and defend depositions, handle court appearances, perform research, and prepare for and attend trials/arbitration hearings;
  • Sociable: You can relate to clients and defense counsel, and progress cases efficiently;
  • Organization: Highly organized and capable of managing a large caseload; and
  • Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using Word, Adobe, Clio, Google Drive, Gmail, One/First Legal, LexisNexis, and various legal AI tools

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Class and PAGA Experience
  • Big Law Experience
  • Trial Experience

PAY : The base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $150,000 per year––commensurate with experience–– plus other benefits (below).

BENEFITS/PERKS:
  • Fully remote
  • Origination Fees: Percentage of attorney's fees for matters you bring into the firm
  • Annual Discretionary Bonus
  • Health Insurance: 100% employer-paid health insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Retirement Plan; and
  • Firm-Sponsored Continuing Legal Education (CLE): Firm-paid CLE courses and bar dues

description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Associate Project Coordinator to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will assist in the planning, execution, and finalization of projects according to strict deadlines and within budget. This includes coordinating the efforts of team members and third-party contractors or consultants to deliver projects according to plan. The Associate Project Coordinator will also assist in defining the project’s objectives and oversee quality control throughout its life cycle.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the definition of project scope, goals, and deliverables that support business goals.

  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects.

  • Support the development of detailed project plans to monitor and track progress.

  • Attend internal meetings and provide project updates to stakeholders.

  • Manage changes to the project scope, schedule, and costs using appropriate verification techniques.

  • Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques.

  • Report and escalate issues to management as needed.

  • Establish and maintain relationships with clients and all stakeholders.

  • Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the team and improve workflow.
